timeoutObservation.issue: Sol T3-R1: in Playwright 1.56.1 all test fixture teardowns share one After Hooks slot (workerMain.js:316-336) and later teardowns are skipped once it is exhausted (fixtureRunner.js:111-124), so an in-fixture end mark cannot record a close that timed out; the stock artifact fixture (timeout 0) still runs afterwards.
timeoutObservation.method: At each stage begin the remaining time of the current shared slot is read read-only (testInfo._timeoutManager.currentSlotDeadline() vs playwright-core monotonicTime) and an unref'd passive timer writes stage.deadline at that instant. No deadline, retry, fixture or production behaviour is changed. A close is completed only if the public BrowserContext 'close' event fired (client close() awaits it).
timeoutObservation.classification: A stage end not observed in-test is UNRESOLVED (worker-teardown fallback mark, never a cutoff) and resolved only from the report: 'timedOut' -> FAILED timeout cut off at the stage.deadline mark; relevant events from 250 ms before to 1000 ms after it -> indeterminate-near-cutoff; no deadline mark -> indeterminate-no-stage-window. Interrupted ends (testInfo._wasInterrupted, status stays 'skipped') and any other report status -> CENSORED, never an independent T failure.
timeoutObservation.exactness: Bounded, not exact: the mark can precede Playwright's own timeout by inter-fixture gaps and follow it by timer latency; the tolerance window absorbs this and reports indeterminate rather than guessing. The internal accessors are source-verified for the fingerprinted install only.
timeoutObservation.sensitivity: selfcheck S18 normal stock skip completion; S19 exhausted close slot with an acknowledgement between timeout and worker cleanup (timeout retained, ack stays late, naive fallback cutoff shown wrong); S20 acknowledgement within tolerance -> indeterminate; S21 interrupted, skipped-after-exhaustion, missing-report and no-deadline captures -> CENSORED or indeterminate. These exercise the analyser and resolution on synthetic marks in the spec's order; the live fixture path itself is exercised only by T3.

outcomes.indeterminate-near-cutoff / indeterminat: Recorded as an unordered or incomplete capture; supports neither a T recurrence nor its absence for that cycle.
outcomes.close-timeout, deleteContext-unacknowled: First exact-ownership capture of the T boundary through the stock path; reports the per-browser ordinal and outstanding commands. It shows the stock bundle can express T on this host; because T1/T2 ran in a different session, it does not by itself prove which bundle element (or host state) was missing from the manual approximation.
outcomes.close-timeout, close-before-deleteContex: A different, Playwright-side boundary (trace stopChunk / temporary screenshot before deletion); classified separately, not a recurrence of the historical T.
outcomes.fixtures.setup timeout: A separately classified setup boundary (context/page creation or init scripts).
outcomes.all 300 tests skipped cleanly: Non-reproduction within 150 stock contexts per browser under the recorded host state. Together with batch 1 (no N in four minimal arms that historically stalled at 75), the current environment expresses neither boundary; further synthetic arms are presently non-informative, and the author will write the bounded intermediate FINDINGS instead of proposing more runs.
outcomes.never: No outcome establishes a cause, a safe context threshold, tracing necessity, or exact historical workers2 ownership.
